findings.note: Blueprint 'Evidence system' requires every major technical claim to point to maintainable evidence (Git version, test result, architecture artifact). Site claims durable checkpoints, capability-aware routing, independent verification, resume-recovery with zero evidence links (no repo link anywhere in either diff). Fix: link public repo and/or soften claims before launch. Build order step 4 foresees proof; claims already present at step 2.

Pricing (5 EUR / 99-149 EUR) ships ahead of blueprint build-order step 7 ('pricing only when commercial packaging is clear'). Justified as separate owner-decided beta service, not platform pricing; recorded, not a violation.

Page gaps vs blueprint core pages: no /product /architecture /security /use-cases /developers /funding /company /contact (contact via mailto+impressum only). Per build order steps 3-6, future work; mapped, not defects.
Repo Reality Check 48h-delivery promise demonstrability depends on owner capacity (human gate Dennis). No fabrication on-site; fulfillment is operational, not content.

positives: hub illustration + demo report explicitly labeled as examples/synthetic
CTAs more honest than blueprint suggestion (waitlist vs demo that does not exist yet)
visual direction matches: dark, calm, no fake dashboards, no stock AI imagery
fail-closed + human gates + no-spending claims match product safety rules
verdict: COMPLIANT at build-order step 2 (simple landing); 1 LOW (evidence links) + 3 INFOs; no launch-blocker beyond already-routed legal/payment gates
